summary: Changes how overview estimates subscription spend (previous-renewal based, loads inactive subscriptions too), adds cancelled_at column set on switch-off, shows Cancel Date and prev renewal, bumps packages.

statements.why: Totals are overstated: index.js drops ?active=true and subscriptions switched off before this commit have no cancelled_at, so they count as paid. Also a schema change with no migration (the card does flag that separately).

statements.text: The app page now says "Estimated spent amount for selected date range."
The agent changed the subscriptions all and subscriptions update parts of your server in ways plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: /all returns every subscription with extra fields; /update saves cancelled_at; both login-scoped.

statements.text: Subscriptions now also store the cancelled date.
Update your database: run `npx prisma migrate dev` (live: `npx prisma migrate deploy`). The database's structure changed, but no migration was created.
statements.why: Column must be added, but project uses `prisma db push` (npm run dbpush), not migrations; migrate deploy won't add it.

misses.what: The overview's estimated spend (total spent/balance) changes: formula counts from the previous renewal date, and subscriptions turned off before this change (no cancel date) count as paid again, inflating totals.
Switching a subscription off now records today as its cancel date (new 'Cancel Date' column); switching on clears it. Renewal column now shows dates for inactive subscriptions plus a 'prev:' date.
/api/subscriptions/all now returns all columns (whitelist removed), including internal ones like nameHash/user_id, only for the user's own rows.
